newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-MIM sees Mt Isa copper losses -paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-MIM sees Mt Isa copper losses -paper.

text.p: A senior executive of MIM Holdings Ltd has said the base metals miner expected to make a loss from copper operations at its Mt Isa mine in the current year, The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reported on Monday.
"MIM expects its Mt Isa operations to run up substantial losses in the current year," The Herald said.

"The copper number could be below the line this year if the copper price stays around where it is and the exchange rate is maintained at the current level," Phil Wright, general manager of Mt Isa operations, was quoted as saying by the newspaper.
Last month MIM reported a net profit for the year to June 30 of A$170.6 million, but its net profit before abnormals was A$29.8 million.
MIM said then the volatility of exchange rates and prices meant it was too difficult to forecast the 1996/97 result, except to say that it would be difficult because of low copper prices.
MIM shares closed down two cents at A$1.49 on Friday.
